युयोध्य् अस्मद् द्वेषांसि //
text_mt:
Om.
Up let all the gods bear you, O Agni, with their thoughts;
so be gracious to us, fair of face, rich in light!
Go forward, O Agni, full of light, with your gracious flames;
shining with vast rays, harm not the creatures with your body!
Agni roared…
O lord of food, give us of food, free from disease, invigorating;
advance the giver, bestow refreshment on us, on biped, on quadruped!
Honor Agni with fuel…
Far and wide is heard this [fire] of Bharata, when he shines forth like the sun, with vast light,
he who stood over the Pūru in battles; the divine guest has shone, gracious to us.
O divine waters, accept this ash; make it rest in a soft and fragrant place;
let the women, good wives, bow to him; bear him gently, as a mother her son!
In the waters, O Agni, is your seat; you hold fast to the plants;
you are born again in the womb.
You are the womb of the plants, the womb of the forest trees;
you are the womb of every creature; O Agni, you are the womb of the waters.
Having settled, O Agni, with ash in your womb, in the waters and the earth,
uniting with the mothers, full of light, sit down again!
Having sat again in your seat, in the waters and the earth, O Agni,
you lie down, most gracious, as if in the lap of a mother within her.
Again with refreshment… together with wealth…
Heed this speech of mine, O youngest, most generous, offered [to you], O self-willed one!
One finds fault, another praises; a singer of praise, I praise your body, O Agni!
Wake, O patron, bounteous, giver of goods, lord of goods!
Ward off the hatreds from us!

meaning:
अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातो ये ऽत्र स्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः /
अदाद् यमो ऽवसानं पृथिव्या अक्रन्न् इमं पितरो लोकम् अस्मै //
संज्ञानम् असि कामधरणं मयि ते कामधरणं भूयात् /
अग्नेर् भस्मासि /
अग्नेः पुरीषम् असि /
चित स्थ परिचितस् ऊर्ध्वचितः श्रयध्वम् //
अयं सो अग्निर् यस्मिन् सोमम् इन्द्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः /
सहस्रिणं वाजम् अत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान् सन् स्तूयसे जातवेदः //
अग्ने दिवो अर्णम् अच्छा जिगास्य् अच्छा देवां ऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये /
याश् चावस्ताद् उपतिष्ठन्त आपो या वा परो रोचने सूर्यस्य //
अग्ने यत् ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यत् पर्वतेष्व् ओषधीष्व् अपसु /
येनान्तरिक्षम् उर्व् आततन्थ त्वेषः स भानुर् अर्णवो नृचक्षाः //
पुरीष्यासो अग्नयः प्रावणेभिः सजोषसः /
जुषन्तां हव्यम् आहुतम् अनमीवा इषो महीः //
इडाम् अग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध /
स्यान् नः सूनुस् तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर् भूत्व् अस्मे //
अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियः //
चिद् असि /
तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद /
परिचिद् असि /
तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद //
समितं संकल्पेथां संप्रियौ रोचिष्णू सुमनस्यमानौ /
इषम् ऊर्जम् अभि संवसानौ //
सं वां मनांसि सं व्रता सम् उ चित्तान्य् आकरम् /
अग्ने पुरीष्याधिपा भव त्वं न इषम् ऊर्जं यजमानाय धेहि //
अग्ने त्वं पुरीष्यो रयिमान् पुष्टिमां असि /
शिवाः कृत्वा दिशः सर्वाः स्वं योनिम् इहासदः //
भवतं नः समनसौ //
मातेव पुत्रं पृथिवी पुरीष्यम् अग्निं स्वे योनाव् अभार् उखा /
तां विश्वे देवा ऋतुभिः संविदानाः प्रजापतिर् विश्वकर्मा विमुञ्चतु //
text_mt:
Go away, depart, crawl away from here, you who are here of old and you who are new!
Yama has granted a resting-place on earth; the fathers have made this world for him.
You are accord, containing desire; may there be the containment of desire in me for you.
You are the ash of Agni.
You are the loose earth of Agni.
You are the piled ones; you are the side-piles; rest upright, you upward-piles!
This is that Agni in whom Indra placed the pressed soma in his belly, yearning for it;
having won thousandfold prize, like a racing steed, you are praised, O Jātavedas!
O Agni, you go toward the flood of heaven; you have spoken to the gods who belong to the hearths,
and to the waters that attend below, or those beyond the realm of the sun.
O Agni, what splendor is yours in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the plants, in the waters,
with which you have stretched through the wide atmosphere—flashing is that light, overflowing, men-beholding.
May the fires of the loose earth, together with the streams, being of one accord,
enjoy the offered oblation, the disease-free, great refreshments!
Effect for the caller, O Agni, bountiful nourishment of many wonders, the gain of cattle, lasting forever;
may our son and offspring be fruitful; O Agni, let that goodwill of yours be ours!
This is your seasonable womb…
You are the gathering-stone;
with that deity, like Aṅgiras, sit firm!
You are the surrounding-stone;
with that deity, like Aṅgiras, sit firm!
Come together, unite your purposes, beloved, radiant, well-minded,
clothing yourselves together in refreshment and vigor!
I have united your minds, united your vows, and united your thoughts;
O Agni, of the loose earth, become our overlord; place refreshment and vigor in the sacrificer!
O Agni, you belong to the loose earth, possessing wealth, possessing nourishment;
having made all quarters gracious, sit down here in your own womb!
Be of one mind for us…
As a mother her son, the earth has borne in her own womb Agni belonging to the loose earth, the pot;
may all the gods, in agreement with the seasons, may Prajāpati Viśvakarman release her!

yad asya pāre rajasaś citraṃ jyotir ajāyata /
tan naḥ parṣad ati dviṣo agne vaiśvānara dyumat //
asunvantam ayajamānam iccha stenasyetyāṃ taskarasyānvihi /
anyam asmad iccha sā ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyam astu //
yat te asmin ghora āsan juhomy eṣāṃ bandhānām avasarjanāya kam /

ūrjo bhāgaṃ madhumat pinvamānāsmān sīte payasābhyāvavṛtsva //

jyotir āpāma //
kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva mitrāya varuṇāya ca /
indrāyāśvibhyāṃ pūṣṇe prajābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ //
meaning:
यद् अस्य पारे रजसश् चित्रं ज्योतिर् अजायत /
तन् नः पर्षद् अति द्विषो अग्ने वैश्वानर द्युमत् //
असुन्वन्तम् अयजमानम् इच्छ स्तेनस्येत्यां तस्करस्यान्विहि /
अन्यम् अस्मद् इच्छ सा त इत्या नमो देवि निरृते तुभ्यम् अस्तु //
यत् ते अस्मिन् घोर आसन् जुहोम्य् एषां बन्धानाम् अवसर्जनाय कम् /
यां त्वा जनो भूमिर् इति प्रमन्दते निरृतिर् इति त्वाहं परि वेद विश्वतः //
नमः सु ते निरृते तिग्मतेजो ऽयस्मयं विचृता बन्धम् एतम् /
यमेन त्वं यम्या संविदानोत्तमे नाके अधि रोहयैनम् //
यं ते देवी निरृतिर् आबबन्ध पाशं ग्रीवास्व् अविचर्त्यम् /
तं ते विष्याम्य् आयुषो नु मध्ये ऽधा विषितः पितुमद् धि प्रमुक्तः //
निवेशनः संगमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभिचष्टे शचीभिः /
देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे पथीनाम् //
सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वितन्वते पृथक् /
धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया //
युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनोत कृतो योनिर् वपतेह बीजम् /
गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन् नो नेदीय इत् सृण्यः पक्वम् एयात् //
पूषा युनक्तु सविता युनक्तु बृहस्पतिः सविता देवो अग्निः //
शुनं सुफाला वितुदन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अभियन्तु वाहान् /
शुनासीरा हव्यजुष्टिं जुषाणेदं बीजम् अवतम् उप्यमानम् //
लाङ्गलं पवीरवं सुशेवं सोमपित्सरु /
उद् इद् वपति गाम् अविं प्रस्थावद् रथवाहनं प्रफर्व्यं च पीवरीम् //
घृतेन सीता मधुना समज्यतां विश्वैर् देवैर् अनुमतं मरुद्भिः /
ऊर्जो भागं मधुमत् पिन्वमानास्मान् सीते पयसाभ्याववृत्स्व //
विमुच्यध्वम् अघ्न्या देवयाना अगन्म तमसस् पारम् /
ज्योतिर् आपाम //
कामं कामदुघे धुक्ष्व मित्राय वरुणाय च /
इन्द्रायाश्विभ्यां पूष्णे प्रजाभ्य ओषधीभ्यः //
text_mt:
The wondrous light that was born on the further side of this dark space,
with that, bright, carry us beyond the haters, O Agni Vaiśvānara!
Seek him who presses not, who sacrifices not; follow the path of the thief, of the robber!
Seek another than us; that is your path; homage be to you, O divine Nirṛti!
What I offer in your frightful mouth, to effect the untying of these bonds—
you whom people fondly imagine to be the earth, I know you entirely as Nirṛti.
Homage indeed to you, O Nirṛti of sharp glow! Loosen this iron bond;
in agreement with Yama and Yamī, raise him up to the highest firmament!
The unloosable fetter that the goddess Nirṛti has bound upon your neck,
that I untie for you now in the middle of life; then, untied, released, eat nourishing food!
Dwelling-place, gatherer of goods, he looks upon all forms through his powers;
like god Savitṛ of true ordinances, like Indra, he stood at the meeting of paths.
The poets yoke the plows; separately they stretch the yokes,
wise, seeking favor among the gods.
Yoke the plows, stretch the yokes; the womb is made, sow the seed here!
Through our song may there be an abundant harvest for us; let the sickle come closer to the ripe grain!
May Pūṣan yoke, may Savitṛ yoke, may Bṛhaspati, Savitṛ, god Agni [yoke]!
May the good plowshares cut the earth auspiciously; may the plowmen follow the draft animals auspiciously;
O Śunāsīra, enjoying the favor of the oblation, protect this seed that is being sown!
The lancet-pointed plow, very gentle, with handle for soma-drinking,
turns up cow, sheep, thriving cart with team, and plump young maiden.
Let the furrow be anointed with ghee, with honey, approved by all the gods, the Maruts;
swelling, full of honey, with a portion of vigor, turn to us, O furrow, with milk!
Be unyoked, O unslayable cows, traveling the gods' path; we have reached the further shore of darkness;
we have attained the light!
Yield your desire, O wish-granting cow, to Mitra and Varuṇa,
to Indra, to the Aśvins, to Pūṣan, to offspring, to plants!

yā oṣadhayaḥ prathamajās devebhyas triyugaṃ purā /
manai nu babhrūṇām ahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca //
śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasram uta vo ruhaḥ /
adhā śatakrato yūyam imaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta //
puṣpavatīḥ prasūmatīḥ phalinīr aphalā uta /
aśvā iva sajitvarīr vīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ //
oṣadhīr iti mātaras tad vo devīr upabruve /
rapāṃsi vighnatīr ita rakṣaś cātayamānāḥ //
aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣ kṛtā /
gobhāja it kilāsatha yat sanavatha pūruṣam //
aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīm ūrjayantīm udojasam /
āvitsi sarvā oṣadhīr asmā ariṣṭatātaye //
yad oṣadhayaḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāv iva /
vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣag rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ //
uc chuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhād iverate /
dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnām ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa //
ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajam akramuḥ /
oṣadhayaḥ prācucyavur yat kiṃca tanvo rapaḥ //
yās ta ātasthur ātmānam āviviśuḥ paruṣparuḥ /
tās te yakṣmaṃ vibādhantām ugro madhyamaśīr iva //
yad ahaṃ vājayann imā oṣadhīr hasta ādadhe /
ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā //
niṣkṛtir nāma vo mātātho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ /
sīrāḥ patatriṇī sthana yad āmayati niṣkṛtha //
sākaṃ yakṣma prapata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā /
sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā //
anyā vo anyām avatv anyānyasyā upāvata /
tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ //
avapatantīr avadan divo 'ntebhyas pari /
yaṃ jīvam aśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ //
meaning:
या ओषधयः प्रथमजास् देवेभ्यस् त्रियुगं पुरा /
मनै नु बभ्रूणाम् अहं शतं धामानि सप्त च //
शतं वो अम्ब धामानि सहस्रम् उत वो रुहः /
अधा शतक्रतो यूयम् इमं मे अगदं कृत //
पुष्पवतीः प्रसूमतीः फलिनीर् अफला उत /
अश्वा इव सजित्वरीर् वीरुधः पारयिष्णवः //
ओषधीर् इति मातरस् तद् वो देवीर् उपब्रुवे /
रपांसि विघ्नतीर् इत रक्षश् चातयमानाः //
अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष् कृता /
गोभाज इत् किलासथ यत् सनवथ पूरुषम् //
अश्वावतीं सोमावतीम् ऊर्जयन्तीम् उदोजसम् /
आवित्सि सर्वा ओषधीर् अस्मा अरिष्टतातये //
यद् ओषधयः समग्मत राजानः समिताव् इव /
विप्रः स उच्यते भिषग् रक्षोहामीवचातनः //
उच् छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठाद् इवेरते /
धनं सनिष्यन्तीनाम् आत्मानं तव पूरुष //
अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेन इव व्रजम् अक्रमुः /
ओषधयः प्राचुच्यवुर् यत् किंच तन्वो रपः //
यास् त आतस्थुर् आत्मानम् आविविशुः परुष्परुः /
तास् ते यक्ष्मं विबाधन्ताम् उग्रो मध्यमशीर् इव //
यद् अहं वाजयन्न् इमा ओषधीर् हस्त आदधे /
आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा //
निष्कृतिर् नाम वो माताथो यूयं स्थ निष्कृतीः /
सीराः पतत्रिणी स्थन यद् आमयति निष्कृथ //
साकं यक्ष्म प्रपत चाषेण किकिदीविना /
साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया //
अन्या वो अन्याम् अवत्व् अन्यान्यस्या उपावत /
ताः सर्वाः संविदाना इदं मे प्रावता वचः //
अवपतन्तीर् अवदन् दिवो ऽन्तेभ्यस् परि /
यं जीवम् अश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः //
text_mt:
The plants that were born first, three ages before the gods—
now shall I praise in thought the hundred and seven stations of the brown ones.
A hundred, O mother, are your stations, and a thousand your shoots;
therefore, you of a hundred powers, make this man healthy for me!
Flowering, bearing shoots, fruitful, and fruit-less,
like winning mares, the conquering plants carry [us] across.
"Plants," O mothers, thus I address you, O goddesses:
away with the afflictions, driving off the demons!
In the aśvattha is your seat, in the parṇa your dwelling is made;
cattle-winners indeed shall you be, since you win the man.
Rich in horses, rich in soma, invigorating, strengthening—
all the plants have I found for his safety.
When the plants gather together, like kings in assembly,
that priest is called a healer, demon-slayer, chaser of disease.
Upward rise the powers of the plants, as cows go out from the pen,
[seeking] to win wealth, the breath of life of your person, O man.
They have stepped over all obstacles, as a thief over an enclosure;
the plants have driven away whatever affliction was in the body.
Those that entered your self, that penetrated limb by limb,
let them thrust away your consumption, like a fierce mediator.
When, seeking vigor, I take these plants in hand,
the life of consumption perishes, like [a culprit] before a captor.
Restoration is the name of your mother, and you are restorers;
you are streams, winged ones; what is sick you make sound.
Together with the blue jay, fly forth, O consumption, together with the kingfisher;
together with the blast of wind, together with the whirlwind, perish!
Let one of you help the other, let one assist the other;
all of you, in accord, promote this utterance of mine!
Falling down, they spoke from the edges of heaven:
"The living man whom we reach, that man shall not come to harm."

mā no hiṃsīj janitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā vyānaṭ /
yaś cāpaś candrāḥ prathamo jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //
abhyāvartasva pṛthivi yajñena payasā saha /
vapāṃ te agnir iṣito arohat //
agne yat te śukraṃ yac candraṃ yat pūtaṃ yac ca yajñiyam /
tad devebhyo bharāmasi //
iṣam ūrjam aham ita ādam ṛtasya yoniṃ mahiṣasya dhārām /
ā no goṣu viśatv ā tanūṣu jahāmi sedim anirām amīvām //
agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso /

ūrjo napāj jātavedaḥ suśastibhir mandasva dhītibhir hitaḥ /

sa darśatasya vapuṣo virājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ rayim //

bhavā vājasya saṃgathe //
saṃ te payāṃsi sam u yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ /

meaning:
मा नो हिंसीज् जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा व्यानट् /
यश् चापश् चन्द्राः प्रथमो जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम //
अभ्यावर्तस्व पृथिवि यज्ञेन पयसा सह /
वपां ते अग्निर् इषितो अरोहत् //
अग्ने यत् ते शुक्रं यच् चन्द्रं यत् पूतं यच् च यज्ञियम् /
तद् देवेभ्यो भरामसि //
इषम् ऊर्जम् अहम् इत आदम् ऋतस्य योनिं महिषस्य धाराम् /
आ नो गोषु विशत्व् आ तनूषु जहामि सेदिम् अनिराम् अमीवाम् //
अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो /
बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजम् उक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे //
पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उद् इयर्षि भानुना /
पुत्रः पितरा विचरन्न् उपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे //
ऊर्जो नपाज् जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर् मन्दस्व धीतिभिर् हितः /
त्वे विश्वे संदधुर् भूरिवर्पसश् चित्रोतयो वामजाताः //
इरज्यन्न् अग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिर् अस्मे रायो अमर्त्य /
स दर्शतस्य वपुषो विराजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं रयिम् //
ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतम् अग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः /
श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा युजा विप्रासो मानुषा युगा //
निष्कर्तारम् अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसे महे /
रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीम् इषं पृणक्षि दर्शतं क्रतुम् //
आप्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् /
भवा वाजस्य संगथे //
सं ते पयांसि सम् उ यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्य् अभिमातिषाहः /
आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्य् उत्तमानि धिष्व //
text_mt:
May he not harm us, he who is the creator of the earth, or who, whose laws are true, pervaded heaven,
and who first brought forth the shining waters; to what god should we offer worship with oblation?
Turn towards [us], O earth, along with sacrifice, with milk;
sent forth, Agni climbed your omentum.
What is bright of you, O Agni, what is shining, what is pure, and what is worthy of sacrifice,
that we bring to the gods.
Food and refreshment I took from here, the womb of cosmic order, the stream of the buffalo;
let it enter our cattle, enter our bodies; I abandon debility, poverty, and disease.
O Agni, your fame, your youthful vigor is great; your flames shine, O rich in light;
O vast in ray, by your might you grant laudable prize to the offerer, O sage!
Purifying-shining, bright-shining, undiminished in shine, you rise up with your ray;
a son, roaming between the two parents, you assist them; you fill both heaven and earth.
O Child of Strength, O Jātavedas, take delight in good praises, established by our thoughts;
in you all [gods] of manifold forms, of wondrous helps, born of pleasant things, have united.
Ruling, O Agni, spread abroad with your creatures, [bringing] riches to us, O immortal one!
You shine over the lovely form; you bestow enduring wealth.
The righteous buffalo, visible to all, people have placed in front, Agni, for goodwill—
the wide-eared, the most expansive one, through you as ally, O sage, across human generations.
The restorer of the rite, the wise one, ruling over great treasure,
a gracious gift of pleasing things, great nourishment you unite with lovely wisdom.
Swell up! Let your virility gather from all sides, O Soma;
become [a center] in the assembly of the prize!
Let your milks gather together, and your prizes, and virile powers that overcome the hostile;
swelling for immortality, O Soma, hold the highest glories in heaven!

meaning:
अपां पृष्ठम् असि //
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद् वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः /
स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश् च योनिम् असतश् च विवः //
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिर् एक आसीत् /
स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम //
द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द //
नमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्यो ये के च पृथिव्याम् अधि /
ये अन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः //
य इषवो यातुधानानां ये वा वनस्पतींर् अनु /
ये वावटेषु शेरते तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः //
ये वादो रोचने दिवो ये वा सूर्यस्य रश्मिषु /
ये अप्सु सदांसि चक्रिरे तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः //
कृणुष्व पाजः प्रसितिं न पृथ्वीं याहि राजेवामवां इभेन /
तृष्वीम् अनु प्रसितिं द्रूणानो ऽस्तासि विध्य रक्षसस् तपिष्ठैः //
तव भ्रमास आशुया पतन्त्य् अनुस्पृश धृषता शोशुचानः /
तपूंष्य् अग्ने जुह्वा पतङ्गान् असंदितो विसृज विष्वग् उल्काः //
प्रति स्पशो विसृज तूर्णितमो भवा पायुर् विशो अस्या अदब्धः /
यो नो दूरे अघशंसो यो अन्त्य् अग्ने माकिष् टे व्यथिर् आदधर्षीत् //
उद् अग्ने तिष्ठ प्रत्यातनुष्व न्य् अमित्रां ओषतात् तिग्महेते /
यो नो अरातिं समिधान चक्रे नीचा तं धक्ष्य् अतसं न शुष्कम् //
ऊर्ध्वो भव प्रतिविध्याध्य् अस्मद् आविष् कृणुष्व दैव्यान्य् अग्ने /
अव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनां जामिम् अजामिं प्रमृणीहि शत्रून् //
अग्नेस् त्वा तेजसा सादयामि /
इन्द्रस्य त्वौजसा सादयामि //
अयम् अग्निः [ सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः / ]
[ मूर्धा कवी रयीणां // ... // ]
text_mt:
You are the back of the waters.
The sacred formulation born first in the east, Vena revealed from the shining boundary;
he laid bare its fundamental, lowest seats, and the womb of being and non-being.
Hiraṇyagarbha arose in the beginning; born, he was the sole lord of what has come to be;
he upheld this earth and heaven; to what god should we offer worship with oblation?
The drop fell down.
Homage be to the serpents, whatever ones are upon the earth,
those in the intermediate space, those in heaven: to those serpents, homage!
Those that are the arrows of sorcerers, or those upon trees,
or those that lie in pits: to those serpents, homage!
Or those there in the brightness of heaven, or those in the rays of the sun,
those that have made their seats in the waters: to those serpents, homage!
Set forth your power as a broad net; march like a mighty king with his elephant;
following your swift net, rushing along, an archer, pierce the demons with your hottest [arrows]!
Swiftly fly your wanderings; shining boldly, touch [them] around;
O Agni, with your tongue send forth burning darts, flying sparks, unchained, meteor-torches everywhere!
Send forth your scouts, be most swift, be an unbeguiled protector of this people;
whoever speaks evil against us from afar, whoever from near, O Agni, let no affliction of yours harm us!
Stand up, O Agni, stretch yourself out; burn down the foes, O sharp-weaponed one!
Whoever made hostility against us, O kindled one, burn him down like dry brushwood!
Be upright, shoot for us, make manifest the divine powers, O Agni;
slacken the firm [bowstrings] of those driven by sorcery, crush the enemies, kin and non-kin!
With the luster of Agni I seat you.
With the power of Indra I seat you.
This Agni [is the lord of a thousand prizes, of a hundred,
the head, the poet of riches...]

sanskrit_iast:
yo agnir agnes tapaso 'dhi jātaḥ śokāt pṛthivyā uta vā divas pari /
yena prajā viśvakarmā jajāna tam agne heḍaḥ pari te vṛṇaktu //
imaṃ mā hiṃsīr dvipādaṃ paśūnāṃ sahasrākṣa medha ācīyamānaḥ /
mayuṃ paśuṃ medham agne jaṣasva tena cinvānas tanvaṃ niṣīda //
mayuṃ te kṣut /
yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
imaṃ mā hiṃsīr ekaśaphaṃ paśūnāṃ kanikradaṃ vājinaṃ vājineṣu /
gauram āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanvaṃ niṣīda //
gauraṃ te kṣut /
yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
imaṃ sāhasraṃ śatadhāram utsaṃ vyacyamānaṃ sarirasya madhye /
ghṛtaṃ duhānām aditiṃ janāyāgne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman //
gavayam āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanvaṃ niṣīda //
gavayaṃ te kṣut /
yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
imam ūrṇāyuṃ varuṇasya nābhiṃ tvacaṃ paśūnāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām /
tvaṣṭuḥ prajānāṃ prathamaṃ janitram agne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman /
meṣam āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanvaṃ niṣīda //
meṣaṃ te kṣut /
yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
ajo hy agner ajaniṣṭa śokāt so apaśyañ janitāram agre /
tena devā devatām agram āyaṃs tena roham āyann upa medhyāsaḥ /
śarabham āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanvaṃ niṣīda //
śarabhaṃ te kṣut /
yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
meaning:
यो अग्निर् अग्नेस् तपसो ऽधि जातः शोकात् पृथिव्या उत वा दिवस् परि /
येन प्रजा विश्वकर्मा जजान तम् अग्ने हेडः परि ते वृणक्तु //
इमं मा हिंसीर् द्विपादं पशूनां सहस्राक्ष मेध आचीयमानः /
मयुं पशुं मेधम् अग्ने जषस्व तेन चिन्वानस् तन्वं निषीद //
मयुं ते क्षुत् /
यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //
इमं मा हिंसीर् एकशफं पशूनां कनिक्रदं वाजिनं वाजिनेषु /
गौरम् आरण्यम् अनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस् तन्वं निषीद //
गौरं ते क्षुत् /
यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //
इमं साहस्रं शतधारम् उत्सं व्यच्यमानं सरिरस्य मध्ये /
घृतं दुहानाम् अदितिं जनायाग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन् //
गवयम् आरण्यम् अनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस् तन्वं निषीद //
गवयं ते क्षुत् /
यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //
इमम् ऊर्णायुं वरुणस्य नाभिं त्वचं पशूनां द्विपदां चतुष्पदाम् /
त्वष्टुः प्रजानां प्रथमं जनित्रम् अग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन् /
मेषम् आरण्यम् अनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस् तन्वं निषीद //
मेषं ते क्षुत् /
यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //
अजो ह्य् अग्नेर् अजनिष्ट शोकात् सो अपश्यञ् जनितारम् अग्रे /
तेन देवा देवताम् अग्रम् आयंस् तेन रोहम् आयन्न् उप मेध्यासः /
शरभम् आरण्यम् अनु ते दिशामि तेन चिन्वानस् तन्वं निषीद //
शरभं ते क्षुत् /
यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //

apāṃ tveman sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvodman sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā bhasmani sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā jyotiṣi sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvāyane sādayāmi /
arṇave tvā sadane sādayāmi /

apāṃ tvā kṣaye sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā sadhiṣi sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmi /

apāṃ tvā yonau sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā purīṣe sādayāmi /
apāṃ tvā pāthiṣi sādayāmi /
gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi /

meaning:
अपां त्वेमन् सादयामि /
अपां त्वोद्मन् सादयामि /
अपां त्वा भस्मनि सादयामि /
अपां त्वा ज्योतिषि सादयामि /
अपां त्वायने सादयामि /
अर्णवे त्वा सदने सादयामि /
समुद्रे त्वा सदने सादयामि /
सरिरे त्वा सदने सादयामि /
अपां त्वा क्षये सादयामि /
अपां त्वा सधिषि सादयामि /
अपां त्वा सदने सादयामि /
अपां त्वा सधस्थे सादयामि /
अपां त्वा योनौ सादयामि /
अपां त्वा पुरीषे सादयामि /
अपां त्वा पाथिषि सादयामि /
गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि /
त्रैष्टुभेन जागतेनानुष्टुभेन पाङ्क्तेन त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि //
अयं पुरो भूः /
तस्य प्राणो भौवायनः /
वसन्तः प्राणायनः गायत्री वासन्ती /
गायत्र्या गायत्रम् /
गायत्राद् उपांशुः /
उपांशोस् त्रिवृत् /
त्रिवृतो रथन्तरम् /
वसिष्ठ ऋषिः /
प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया प्राणं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः /
अयं दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मा /
तस्य मनो वैश्वकर्मणम् /
ग्रीष्मो मानसः /
त्रिष्टुब् ग्रैष्मी /
त्रिष्टुभः स्वारम् /
स्वाराद् अन्तर्यामः /
अन्तर्यामात् पञ्चदशः /
पञ्चदशाद् बृहद् /
भरद्वाज ऋषिः /
प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया मनो गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः /
अयं पश्चाद् विश्वव्यचाः /
तस्य चक्षुर् वैश्वव्यचसम् /
वर्षाणि चाक्षुषाणि /
जगती वार्षी /
जगत्या ऋक्समम् /
ऋक्समाच् छुक्रः /
शुक्रात् सप्तदशः /
स्प्तदशाद् वैरूपम् /
जमदग्निर् ऋषिः /
प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया चक्षुर् गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः /
इदम् उत्तरात् स्वः /
तस्य श्रोत्रं सौवम् /
शरच् छ्रौत्री /
अनुष्टुप् शारदी /
अनुष्टुभ ऐडम् /
ऐडान् मन्थी /
मन्थिन एकविम्̐शः /
एकविम्̐शाद् वैराजम् /
विश्वामित्र ऋषिः /
प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया श्रोत्रं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः /
इयम् उपरि मतिः /
तस्या वाङ् मात्या /
हेमन्तो वाच्यः /
पङ्क्तिर् हैमन्ती /
पङ्क्त्या निधनवत् /
निधनवत आग्रायणः /
आग्रायणात् त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशौ /
त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशाभ्यां शाक्वररैवते /
विश्वकर्मर्षिः /
प्रजापतिगृहीतया त्वया वाचं गृह्णामि प्रजाभ्यः //
लोकं पृण च्छिद्रं पृणाथो सीद ध्रुवा त्वम् /
इन्द्राग्नी त्वा बृहस्पतिर् अस्मिन् योनाव् असीषदन् //
ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः /
जन्मन् देवानां विशस् त्रिष्व् आ रोचने दिवः //

meaning:
ध्रुवक्षितिर् ध्रुवयोनिर् ध्रुवासि ध्रुवं योनिम् आसीद साध्या /
उख्यस्य केतुं प्रथमं जुषाणाश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
कुलायिनी घृतवती पुरंधिः स्योने सीद सदने पृथिव्याः /
अभि त्वा रुद्रा वसवो गृणन्त्व् इमा ब्रह्म पीपिहि सौभगाय /
अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
स्वैर् दक्षैर् दक्षपितेह सीद देवानां सुम्ने बृहते रणाय /
पितेवैधि सूनव आ सुशेवः स्वावेशया तन्वा संविशस्व /
अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
अग्नेः पुरीषम् अस्य् अप्सो नाम तां त्वा विश्वे अभिगुणन्तु देवाः /
स्तोमपृष्ठा घृतवतीह सीद प्रजावद् अस्मे द्रविणायजस्व /
अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
अदित्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयाम्य् अन्तरिक्षस्य धर्त्रीं विष्टम्भनीं दिशाम् //
अधिपत्नी भुवनानाम् ऊर्मिर् द्रप्सो अपाम् असि /
विश्वकर्मा त ऋषिर् अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
सजूर् ऋतुभिः सजूर् विधाभिः सजूर् देवैः सजूर् देवैर् वयोनाधैः /
अग्नये त्वा वैश्वानराय /
अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
सजूर् ऋतुभिः सजूर् विधाभिः सजूर् वसुभिः सजू रुद्रैः सजूर् आदित्यैः सजूर् विश्वैर् देवैः सजूर् देवैर् वयोनाधैः /
अग्नये त्वा वैश्वानराय /
अश्विनाध्वर्यू सादयताम् इह त्वा //
प्राणं मे पाहि व्यानं मे पाह्य् अपानं मे पाहि चक्षुर् म उर्विया विभाहि श्रोत्रं मे श्लोकय /

द्विपाद् अव चतुष्पात् पाहि दिवो वा वृष्टिम् एरय //

text_mt: The three-year-old steer is the age, the Gāyatrī is the metre. / The two-and-a-half-year-old steer is the age, the Triṣṭubh is the metre. / The four-year-old steer is the age, the Virāj is the metre. / The three-year-old calf is the age, the Uṣṇih is the metre. / The four-year-old bullock is the age, the Anuṣṭubh is the metre. / The five-year-old bullock is the age, the Bṛhatī is the metre. / The ox is the age, the Kakubh is the metre. / The milch cow is the age, the Jagatī is the metre. / The draft bullock is the age, the Paṅkti is the metre. / The bull is the age, the Satobṛhatī is the metre. / The goat is the age, the Yuvala is the metre. / The ram is the age, the Viśāla is the metre. / The tiger is the age, the Anādhṛṣya is the metre. / The lion is the age, the Chandi is the metre. / Man is the age, the Tandra is the metre. / Dominion is the age, the Mayanda is the metre. / Support is the age, the Adhipati is the metre. / The crown is the age, Prajāpati is the metre. / Viśvakarman is the age, Parameṣṭhin is the metre.

text_mt: O Indra and Agni, make firm the unshakeable brick; / with your back you thrust apart heaven and earth and the intermediate space. / You are the queen, the eastern quarter. / You are the Virāj, the southern quarter. / You are the Samrāj, the western quarter. / You are the Svarāj, the northern quarter. / You are the sovereign mistress, the upward quarter. / Protect my life; protect my out-breath; / protect my diffused breath; protect my in-breath; / protect my sight; protect my hearing; / swell my mind; invigorate my speech; / protect my self; grant me light. / Measure is the metre. / Fore-measure is the metre. / Counter-measure is the metre. / Asrīvayas is the metre. / Paṅkti is the metre. / Uṣṇih is the metre. / Anuṣṭubh is the metre. / Virāj is the metre. / Bṛhatī is the metre. / Gāyatrī is the metre. / Triṣṭubh is the metre. / Jagatī is the metre. / Earth is the metre. / Intermediate space is the metre. / Heaven is the metre. / The year is the metre. / The lunar mansions are the metre. / Speech is the metre. / Mind is the metre. / Agriculture is the metre. / Gold is the metre. / The cow is the metre. / The goat is the metre. / The horse is the metre. / Agni is the deity. / Vāta is the deity. / Sūrya is the deity. / Candramas is the deity. / The Vasus are the deity. / The Rudras are the deity. / The Ādityas are the deity. / The Maruts are the deity. / The Viśve Devas are the deity. / Indra is the deity. / Varuṇa is the deity. / Bṛhaspati is the deity. / You are the crown, the ruler. / You are firm, supporting. / You are the upholder, the earth. / For life [I set] you! / For brilliance [I set] you! / For agriculture [I set] you! / For peace [I set] you! / The restrainer is ruler. / You are the restrainer, the governor. / You are firm, the bearer. / For food [I set] you! / For strength [I set] you! / For wealth [I set] you! / For nourishment [I set] you!

agner bhāgo 'si dīkṣāyā ādhipatyaṃ brahma spṛtaṃ trivṛt stomaḥ //
indrasya bhāgo 'si viṣṇor ādhipatyaṃ kṣatraṃ spṛtaṃ pañcadaśa stomaḥ //
nṛcakṣasāṃ bhāgo 'si dhātur ādhipatyaṃ janitraṃ spṛtaṃ saptadaśa stomaḥ //
mitrasya bhāgo 'si varuṇasyādhipatyaṃ divo vṛṣṭir vāta spṛta ekaviṃśa stomaḥ //
vasūnāṃ bhāgo 'si rudrāṇām ādhipatyaṃ catuṣpāt spṛtaṃ caturviṃśaḥ stomaḥ //
ādityānāṃ bhāgo 'si marutām ādhipatyaṃ garbhā spṛtāḥ pañcaviṃśa stomaḥ /
ādityā bhāgo 'si pūṣṇa ādhipatyam oja spṛtaṃ triṇava stomaḥ //
devasya savitur bhāgo 'si bṛhaspater ādhipatyaṃ samīcīr diśa spṛtāś catuṣṭoma stomaḥ //
yavānāṃ bhāgo 'sy ayavānām ādhipatyaṃ prajā spṛtāś catuścatvāriṃśa stomaḥ //
ṛbhūṇāṃ bhāgo 'si viśveṣāṃ devānām ādhipatyaṃ bhūtaṃ niśāntaṃ trayastriṃśa stomaḥ //
meaning:
आशुस् त्रिवृत् /
भान्तः पञ्चदशः /
व्योमा सप्तदशः /
प्रतूर्तिर् अष्टादशः /
तपो नवदशः /
अभीवर्तः सविंशः /
धरुण एकविम्̐शः /
वर्चो द्वाविंशः /
संभरणस् त्रयोविंशः /
योनिश् चतुर्विंशः /
गर्भाः पञ्चविंशः /
ओजस् त्रिणवः /
क्रतुर् एकत्रिंशः /
प्रतिष्ठा त्रयस्त्रिंशः /
ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं चतुस्त्रिंशः /
नाकः षट्त्रिंशः /
वीवर्तो अष्टाचत्वारिंशः /
धर्त्रं चतुष्टोमः //
अग्नेर् भागो ऽसि दीक्षाया आधिपत्यं ब्रह्म स्पृतं त्रिवृत् स्तोमः //
इन्द्रस्य भागो ऽसि विष्णोर् आधिपत्यं क्षत्रं स्पृतं पञ्चदश स्तोमः //
नृचक्षसां भागो ऽसि धातुर् आधिपत्यं जनित्रं स्पृतं सप्तदश स्तोमः //
मित्रस्य भागो ऽसि वरुणस्याधिपत्यं दिवो वृष्टिर् वात स्पृत एकविंश स्तोमः //
वसूनां भागो ऽसि रुद्राणाम् आधिपत्यं चतुष्पात् स्पृतं चतुर्विंशः स्तोमः //
आदित्यानां भागो ऽसि मरुताम् आधिपत्यं गर्भा स्पृताः पञ्चविंश स्तोमः /
आदित्या भागो ऽसि पूष्ण आधिपत्यम् ओज स्पृतं त्रिणव स्तोमः //
देवस्य सवितुर् भागो ऽसि बृहस्पतेर् आधिपत्यं समीचीर् दिश स्पृताश् चतुष्टोम स्तोमः //
यवानां भागो ऽस्य् अयवानाम् आधिपत्यं प्रजा स्पृताश् चतुश्चत्वारिंश स्तोमः //
ऋभूणां भागो ऽसि विश्वेषां देवानाम् आधिपत्यं भूतं निशान्तं त्रयस्त्रिंश स्तोमः //
text_mt: The swift is the threefold [stoma]. / The shining is the fifteenfold. / The sky is the seventeenfold. / Swift motion is the eighteenfold. / Ascetic heat is the nineteenfold. / The victorious onset is the twentyfold. / The supporting is the twenty-onefold. / Brilliance is the twenty-twofold. / The gathering is the twenty-threefold. / The womb is the twenty-fourfold. / The embryos are the twenty-fivefold. / Might is the thrice-ninefold. / Will is the thirty-onefold. / Firm foundation is the thirty-threefold. / The summit of the ruddy one is the thirty-fourfold. / The firmament is the thirty-sixfold. / The turning away is the forty-eightfold. / The support is the Catuṣṭoma. / You are the share of Agni; the overlordship is of consecration; sacred formulation is preserved; the stoma is the threefold. / You are the share of Indra; the overlordship is of Viṣṇu; dominion is preserved; the stoma is the fifteenfold. / You are the share of the watchers of men; the overlordship is of Dhātṛ; the place of birth is preserved; the stoma is the seventeenfold. / You are the share of Mitra; the overlordship is of Varuṇa; rain of heaven and wind are preserved; the stoma is the twenty-onefold. / You are the share of the Vasus; the overlordship is of the Rudras; the four-footed is preserved; the stoma is the twenty-fourfold. / You are the share of the Ādityas; the overlordship is of the Maruts; the embryos are preserved; the stoma is the twenty-fivefold. / You are the share of Aditi; the overlordship is of Pūṣan; might is preserved; the stoma is the thrice-ninefold. / You are the share of the divine Savitṛ; the overlordship is of Bṛhaspati; the harmonious quarters are preserved; the stoma is the Catuṣṭoma. / You are the share of the bright fortnights; the overlordship is of the dark fortnights; creatures are preserved; the stoma is the forty-fourfold. / You are the share of the Ṛbhus; the overlordship is of the All-gods; what has come into being is set at rest; the stoma is the thirty-threefold.

एकयास्तुवत प्रजा अधीयन्त प्रजापतिर् अधिपतिर् आसीत् /
तिसृभिर् अस्तुवत ब्रह्मासृज्यत ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् अधिपतिर् आसीत् /
पञ्चभिर् अस्तुवत भूतान्य् असृज्यन्त भूतानां पतिर् अधिपतिर् आसीत् /
सप्तभिर् अस्तुवत सप्तर्षयो ऽसृज्यन्त धाताधिपतिर् आसीत् /
नवभिर् अस्तुवत पितरो ऽसृज्यन्तादितिर् अधिपत्न्य् आसीत् /
एकादशभिर् अस्तुवतार्तवा असृज्यन्तर्तवो ऽधिपतय आसन् /
त्रयोदशभिर् अस्तुवत मासा असृज्यन्त संवत्सरो ऽधिपतिर् आसीत् /
पञ्चदशभिर् अस्तुवत क्षत्रम् असृज्यतेन्द्रो ऽधिपतिर् आसीत् /
सप्तदशभिर् अस्तुवत पशवो ऽसृज्यन्त बृहस्पतिर् अधिपतिर् आसीत् /
नवदशभिर् अस्तुवत शूद्रार्याव् असृज्येताम् अहोरात्रे अधिपत्नी आस्ताम् /
एकविंशत्यास्तुवतैकशफाः पशवो ऽसृज्यन्त वरुणो ऽधिपतिर् आसीत् /
त्रयोविंशत्यास्तुवत क्षुद्राः पशवो ऽसृज्यन्त पूषाधिपतिर् आसीत् /
पञ्चविंशत्यास्तुवतारण्याः पशवो ऽसृज्यन्त वायुर् अधिपतिर् आसीत् /
सप्तविंशत्यास्तुवत द्यावापृथिवी व्यैतां वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या अनुव्यायंस् त एवाधिपतय आसन् /
नवविंशत्यास्तुवत वनस्पतयो ऽसृज्यन्त सोमो ऽधिपतिर् आसीत् /
एकत्रिंशतास्तुवत प्रजा असृज्यन्त यवाश् चायवाश् चाधिपतय आसन् /
त्रयस्त्रिंशतास्तुवत भूतान्य् अशाम्यन् प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठ्य् अधिपतिर् आसीत् //
text_mt: With one they praised: creatures were brought forth; Prajāpati was the overlord. / With three they praised: the sacred formulation was created; Brahmaṇaspati was the overlord. / With five they praised: beings were created; the lord of beings was the overlord. / With seven they praised: the seven seers were created; Dhātṛ was the overlord. / With nine they praised: the fathers were created; Aditi was the sovereign mistress. / With eleven they praised: the seasonal periods were created; the seasons were the overlords. / With thirteen they praised: the months were created; the year was the overlord. / With fifteen they praised: dominion was created; Indra was the overlord. / With seventeen they praised: domestic animals were created; Bṛhaspati was the overlord. / With nineteen they praised: the Śūdra and the Arya were created; day and night were the sovereign mistresses. / With twenty-one they praised: single-hoofed animals were created; Varuṇa was the overlord. / With twenty-three they praised: small animals were created; Pūṣan was the overlord. / With twenty-five they praised: wild animals were created; Vāyu was the overlord. / With twenty-seven they praised: heaven and earth departed asunder; the Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas moved along after them; they indeed were the overlords. / With twenty-nine they praised: trees were created; Soma was the overlord. / With thirty-one they praised: creatures were created; the bright and dark fortnights were the overlords. / With thirty-three they praised: beings were appeased; Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin was the overlord.

text_mt: You are the ray: for dwelling, you; invigorate dwelling! / You are the forward course: for cosmic order, you; invigorate cosmic order! / You are following: for heaven, you; invigorate heaven! / You are the conjunction: for the intermediate space, you; invigorate the intermediate space! / You are the cross-beam: for earth, you; invigorate earth! / You are the prop: for rain, you; invigorate rain! / You are blowing forward: for day, you; invigorate day! / You are blowing after: for night, you; invigorate night! / You are the desiring: for the Vasus, you; invigorate the Vasus! / You are the herald: for the Rudras, you; invigorate the Rudras! You are bright light: for the Ādityas, you; invigorate the Ādityas! / You are vigor: for the fathers, you; invigorate the fathers! / You are the thread: for offspring, you; invigorate offspring! / You are conquering hosts: for beasts, you; invigorate beasts! / You are rich: for plants, you; invigorate plants! / You are victorious with yoked press-stones: for Indra, you; invigorate Indra! / You are the overlord: for out-breath, you; invigorate out-breath! / You are the supporter: for in-breath, you; invigorate in-breath! / You are gliding together: for sight, you; invigorate sight! / You are the bestower of vitality: for hearing, you; invigorate hearing! / You are threefold: for the threefold, you! / You are turning along: for turning along, you! / You are advancing: for advancing, you! / You are turning after: for turning after, you! / You are growing together! / You are branching out! / You are sprouting forth! / You are growing after! / You are Vasuka! / You are Vasyaṣṭi! / You are Veṣaśrī! / At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, praise Bṛhaspati!

text_mt: You are the queen, the eastern quarter. / The Vasus are your divine overlords. / Agni is the repeller of missiles. / May the threefold stoma rest you upon the earth! / May the Ājya-śastra prop [you] for firmness! / The Rathantara-sāman [props] the intermediate space for foundation. / May the seers, the firstborn among the gods, extend you with the measure of heaven in breadth! / And this one is the distributor, the overlord. / May all of them, in harmony, seat you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament, in the heavenly world! / You are the Virāj, the southern quarter. / The Rudras are your divine overlords. / Soma is the repeller of missiles. / May the fifteenfold stoma rest you upon the earth! / May the Prauga-śastra prop [you] for firmness! / The Bṛhat-sāman [props] the intermediate space for foundation. / May the seers, the firstborn […] / You are the Samrāj, the western quarter. / The Ādityas are your divine overlords. / Indra is the repeller of missiles. / May the seventeenfold stoma rest you upon the earth! / May the Marutvatīya-śastra prop [you] for firmness! / The Vairūpa-sāman [props] the intermediate space for foundation. / May the seers, the firstborn […] / You are the Svarāj, the northern quarter. / The Maruts are your divine overlords. / Varuṇa is the repeller of missiles. / May the twenty-onefold stoma rest you upon the earth! / May the Niṣkevalya-śastra prop [you] for firmness! / The Vairāja-sāman [props] the intermediate space for foundation. / May the seers, the firstborn […] / You are the sovereign mistress, the upward quarter. / The Viśve Devas are your divine overlords. / Bṛhaspati is the repeller of missiles. / May the thrice-ninefold and thirty-threefold stomas rest you upon the earth! / May the Vaiśvadeva- and Āgnimāruta-śastras prop [you] for firmness! / The Śākvara- and Raivata-sāmans [prop] the intermediate space for foundation. / May the seers, the firstborn among the gods, extend you with the measure of heaven in breadth! / And this one is the distributor, the overlord. / May all of them, in harmony, seat you and the sacrificer on the back of the firmament, in the heavenly world!

text_mt:
This one in front is the golden-haired sunbeam. / Rathakṛtsa and Rathaujā are his army-commander and headman; / Puñjikasthalā and Kṛtasthalā are his two apsarases; / sorcerers are his missile; / demons are his counter-missile. / May they protect us! / May they help us! / Whomever we hate and whoever hates us, him I place in their jaws!
This one on the south is Viśvakarman. / Rathasvana and Rathecitra are his army-commander and headman; / Menakā and Sahajanyā are his two apsarases; / biting beasts are his missile; / slaughter by men is his counter-missile. / May they protect us!
This one on the west is Vidvasu. / Rathaprotha and Asamaratha are his army-commander and headman; / Pramlocantī and Anumlocantī are his two apsarases; / tigers are his missile; / snakes are his counter-missile. / May they protect us!
This one on the north is Saṃyadvasu. / Tārkṣya and Ariṣṭanemi are his army-commander and headman; / Viśvācī and Ghṛtācī are his two apsarases; / the waters are his missile; / the wind is his counter-missile. / May they protect us!
This one above is Arvāgvasu. / Senajit and Suṣeṇa are his army-commander and headman; / Urvaśī and Pūrvacitti are his two apsarases; / the roaring [cloud] is his missile; / lightning is his counter-missile. / May they protect us! / May they help us! / Whomever we hate and whoever hates us, him I place in their jaws!

text_mt:
I seat you in the seat of Ayu, in the shade of the well. / Homage to the ocean! / Homage to the eye of the ocean!
Snorting like a horse wishing for pasture, when he stood forth from the great enclosure, / then the wind blows after his flame; then may your path be black!
May Bṛhaspati seat you on the back of the earth, full of light, for all breath, diffused breath, and downward breath! / Bestow all light! / Agni is your overlord. / May Viśvakarman seat you on the back of the intermediate space, full of light, for all breath, diffused breath, and downward breath! / Bestow all light! / Vāyu is your overlord. / May Prajāpati seat you on the back of heaven, full of light, for all breath, diffused breath, and downward breath! / Bestow all light! / Sūrya is your overlord. / Madhu and Mādhava are the two spring seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni.
May heaven and earth be shaped! May the waters and plants be shaped! / May the fires, adhering to the same vow, each be shaped for my pre-eminence!
Whatever fires, harmonious, are between heaven and earth, / being shaped together with these two spring seasons, may they enter together, like the gods around Indra!
Śukra and Śuci are the two summer seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni. // May [heaven and earth] be shaped!
Nabhas and Nabhasya are the two rainy seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni. // May [heaven and earth] be shaped!
Iṣ and Ūrj are the two autumn seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni. // May [heaven and earth] be shaped!
Sahas and Sahasya are the two winter seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni. // May [heaven and earth] be shaped!
Tapas and Tapasya are the two cool seasons. / You are the inner bond of Agni.
May heaven and earth be shaped! May the waters and plants be shaped! / May the fires, adhering to the same vow, each be shaped for my pre-eminence!
Whatever fires, harmonious, are between heaven and earth, / being shaped together with these two cool seasons, may they enter together, like the gods around Indra!
You are the measure of a thousand. / You are the image of a thousand. / You are the counter-measure of a thousand. / You belong to a thousand. / For a thousand, you! / May these bricks, O Agni, be milch-cows for me:
one and ten, / a hundred and a thousand, / ten thousand and a hundred thousand, / a million and ten million, / ten million and a hundred million, / an ocean and a middle, / an end and a supreme limit! / May those bricks, O Agni, be milch-cows for me!
You are the seasons, growing through the cosmic order; / abiding in the season, touching the season, dripping ghee, dripping honey, full of vigor, possessing svadhā, Virāj by name, yielding desires!

uto ta iṣave namaḥ //

vijyaṃ dhanuḥ kapardino viśalyo bāṇavān uta /
aneśann asyeṣava ābhur asya niṣaṅgadhiḥ //

atho ya iṣudhis tavāre asman nidhehi tam //
namāṃsi ta āyudhāyānātatāya dhṛṣṇave /
ubhābhyām uta te namo bāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvane //
avatatya dhanuṣ ṭvaṃ sahasrākṣa śateṣudhe /
niśīrya śalyānāṃ mukhaṃ śivo naḥ sumanā bhava //
yā ta iṣuḥ śivatamā śivaṃ babhūva te dhanuḥ /
śiva śaravyā yā tava tayā no mṛḍa jīvase //
meaning:
नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे बाहुभ्यामु त ते नमः /
उतो त इषवे नमः //
या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूर् अघोरापापकाशिनी /
तया नस् तन्वा शंतमया गिरिशन्ताभिचाकशीहि /
याम् इषुं गिरिशन्त हस्ते बिभर्ष्य् अस्तवे /
शिवां गिरित्र तां कुरु मा हिंसीः पुरुषं जगत् //
शिवेन वचसा त्वा गिरिशाच्छा वदामसि /
यथा नः सर्वम् इज् जगद् अयक्ष्मं सुमना असत् //
अध्यवोचद् अधिवक्ता प्रथमो दैव्यो भिषक् /
अहींश् च सर्वाञ् जम्भयन् सर्वाश् च यातुधान्यो ऽधराचीः परासुव //
असौ यस् ताम्रो अरुण उत बभ्रुः सुमङ्गलः /
ये चेमे रुद्रा अभितो दिक्षु श्रिताः सहस्रशो ऽवैषां हेड ईमहे //
असौ यो ऽवसर्पति नीलग्रीवो विलोहितः /
उतैनं गोपा अदृश्रन्न् उतैनम् उदहार्यः /
स दृष्टः किं करिष्यति //
नमो ऽस्तु नीलग्रीवाय सहस्राक्षाय मीढुषे /
अथो ये अस्य सत्वानो ऽहं तेभ्यो अकरं नमः //
प्रमुञ्च धन्वनस् त्वम् उभयोर् आर्त्न्योर् ज्याम् /
याश् च ते हस्त इषवः परा ता भगवो वप //
विज्यं धनुः कपर्दिनो विशल्यो बाणवान् उत /
अनेशन्न् अस्येषव आभुर् अस्य निषङ्गधिः //
या ते हेतिर् मीढुष्टम हस्ते बभूव ते धनुः /
तयास्मान् विश्वतस् त्वम् अयक्ष्मेण परिभुज //
परि ते धन्वनो हेतिर् अस्मान् वृणक्तु विश्वतः /
अथो य इषुधिस् तवारे अस्मन् निधेहि तम् //
नमांसि त आयुधायानातताय धृष्णवे /
उभाभ्याम् उत ते नमो बाहुभ्यां तव धन्वने //
अवतत्य धनुष् ट्वं सहस्राक्ष शतेषुधे /
निशीर्य शल्यानां मुखं शिवो नः सुमना भव //
या त इषुः शिवतमा शिवं बभूव ते धनुः /
शिव शरव्या या तव तया नो मृड जीवसे //
text_mt:
Homage, O Rudra, to your wrath, and homage to your two arms! / And homage to your arrow!
That body of yours, O Rudra, which is auspicious, not terrible, revealing no evil, / with that most beneficent body, O dweller on the mountain, look upon us!
The arrow that you bear in your hand, O dweller on the mountain, to shoot, / make that auspicious, O mountain-protector; do not harm man [or] cattle!
With auspicious speech we speak to you, O dweller on the mountain, / so that all this our world of living beings may be free from disease and well-disposed.
The advocate, the first divine physician, has spoken for us; / crushing all serpents and all female sorcerers, drive them away downwards!
Yonder one who is copper-colored, red, and brown, highly auspicious, / and these Rudras who are dwelling around in the quarters by thousands—we avert their wrath.
Yonder blue-necked, deep red one who glides away, / him the cowherds saw, and him the water-carrying maidens saw; / when seen, what will he do?
Homage be to the blue-necked, thousand-eyed one, the bestower! / And those who are his warriors, to them I have paid homage.
Unloose the bowstring from both ends of your bow, / and the arrows that are in your hand, O bountiful one, cast them away!
Unstrung be the bow of the matted-haired one, and tipless his arrow; / gone be his shafts; an empty holder be his quiver!
The missile that is yours, O most generous one, the bow that is in your hand, / with that, protect us on all sides with freedom from disease!
May the missile of your bow avoid us on all sides, / and that quiver of yours, deposit it far away from us!
Homages to your weapon, unbent, bold; / and homage to your two arms, and to your bow!
Having unbent your bow, O thousand-eyed one, with a hundred quivers, / having blunted the point of your arrowheads, become auspicious, well-disposed to us!
The arrow of yours that is most auspicious, auspicious has your bow become; / auspicious is that missile of yours: with that, be gracious to us, that we may live!

text_mt: Homage to the golden-armed commander of the army, and to the lord of the quarters, homage! / Homage to the green-haired trees, to the lord of cattle, homage! / Homage to the grass-red glowing one, to the lord of paths, homage! / Homage to the brown piercer, to the lord of foods, homage! / Homage to the green-haired one wearing the sacred thread, to the lord of the thriving, homage! / Homage to the missile of Bhava, to the lord of moving beings, homage! / Homage to Rudra with strung bow, to the lord of fields, homage! / Homage to the charioteer who cannot be slain, to the lord of forests, homage! / Homage to the red one, the master, to the lord of trees, homage! / Homage to the counsellor, the merchant, to the lord of thickets, homage! / Homage to the expander, the creator of open space, to the lord of plants, homage! / Homage to the one who makes cry out, of loud roar, to the lord of warriors, homage! / Homage to the completely enveloped runner, to the lord of footmen, homage! / Homage to the enduring, piercing one, to the lord of piercing troops, homage! / Homage to the quiver-bearer, the peak, to the lord of thieves, homage! / Homage to the deceiver, the out-and-out deceiver, to the lord of skulkers, homage! / Homage to the roamer within, the roamer around, to the lord of wildernesses, homage! / Homage to the quiver-bearer with arrow-case, to the lord of robbers, homage! / Homage to the arrow-wielders, the killers, to the lord of plunderers, homage! / Homage to the sword-bearers, night-roamers, to the lord of slashers, homage! / Homage to the turban-wearer wandering the hills, to the lord of thieves, homage!

text_mt: Homage to arrow-makers and bow-makers, homage to you! / Homage to those having arrows and those drawing bows, homage to you! / Homage to those stringing [their bows] and those fitting [arrows], homage to you! / Homage to those drawing [the bow] and shooting, homage to you! / Homage to those releasing and piercing, homage to you! / Homage to those sleeping and waking, homage to you! / Homage to those lying down and sitting, homage to you! / Homage to those standing and running, homage to you! / Homage to the assemblies and to the assembly-lords, homage to you! / Homage to the horses and to the horse-masters, homage to you! / Homage to piercing [troops] and violently piercing [troops], homage to you! / Homage to fierce troops and crushing troops, homage to you! / Homage to bands and to band-leaders, homage to you! / Homage to troops and to troop-leaders, homage to you! / Homage to the wretched and to the lords of the wretched, homage to you! / Homage to the misshapen and the all-shaped, homage to you! / Homage to armies and to army-commanders, homage to you! / Homage to charioteers and chariot-guards, homage to you! / Homage to the great and to the small, homage to you! / Homage to chamberlains and charioteers, homage to you! / Homage to carpenters and chariot-builders, homage to you! / Homage to potters and metalsmiths, homage to you! / Homage to fowlers and Niṣādas, homage to you! / Homage to dog-keepers and hunters, homage to you! / Homage to dogs and dog-masters, homage to you! / Homage to Bhava and to Rudra! / Homage to Śarva and to Paśupati! / Homage to the blue-necked and to the white-throated! / Homage to the matted-haired one and to the shaven-haired one! / Homage to the thousand-eyed one and to the hundred-bowed one!

text_mt: Homage to the mountain-dweller and to Śipiviṣṭa! / Homage to the most bountiful and to the arrow-possessing! / Homage to the short one and to the dwarf! / Homage to the great one and to the elder! / Homage to the aged one and to the well-grown! / Homage to the foremost and to the first! / Homage to the swift and to the nimble! / Homage to the rapid and to the fleet! / Homage to the one in the billow and to the one in the sounding waters! / Homage to the one in the river and to the one on the island! / Homage to the eldest and to the youngest! / Homage to the first-born and to the later-born! / Homage to the middle one and to the immature! / Homage to the one at the root and to the one at the tail! / Homage to the one in the realm of Sobha and to the one in the realm of resistance! / Homage to the one with a swift army and to the one with a swift chariot! / Homage to the helmeted one and to the armored one! / Homage to the coat-of-mail wearer and to the chariot-guard! / Homage to the hero and to the piercer! / Homage to the renowned one and to the one with a renowned army! / Homage to Yama's [realm] and to the secure! / Homage to the fertile soil and to the threshing-floor! / Homage to fame and to echo! / Homage to the verse-worthy and to the end-resting! / Homage to the one of the forest and to the one of the thicket! / Homage to the one in the drum and to the one in the drumstick! / Homage to the bold and to the probing! / Homage to the quiver-bearer and to the one with an arrow-case! / Homage to the one with sharp arrows and to the weapon-bearer! / Homage to the one with good weapons and to the one with a good bow!

Homage to the one in the brook and to the one on the path!
Homage to the one in the chasm and to the one at the foot of the hill!
Homage to the one in the river and to the one in the pond!
Homage to the one in the stream and to the one in the lake!
Homage to the one in the well and to the one in the pit!
Homage to the one in the rain and to the one in the absence of rain!
Homage to the one in the cloud and to the one in the lightning!
Homage to the one in clear sky and to the one in the sunshine!
Homage to the one in the gale and to the one in the storm!
Homage to the one of the homestead and to the guardian of the homestead!
Homage to Soma and to Rudra!
Homage to the copper-colored and to the ruddy!
Homage to the bringer of comfort and to the lord of cattle!
Homage to the fierce and to the terrible!
Homage to the slayer and to the further slayer!
Homage to the one who slays in front and to the one who slays from afar!
Homage to the green-haired trees!
Homage to the savior!
Homage to Śaṃbhu and to Mayobhu!
Homage to Śaṃkara and to Mayaskara!
Homage to Śiva and to Śivatara!
Homage to the one in the gravel and to the one in the calm dwelling!
Homage to the one in the barren land and to the one on the high road!
Homage to the one with straight hair and to the matted-haired one!
Homage to the one in the cattle-pen and to the one in the house!
Homage to the one on the couch and to the one in the home!
Homage to the one on this shore and to the one on the further shore!
Homage to the ferryman and to the one crossing over!
Homage to the one at the ford and to the one on the bank!
Homage to the one in the foam and to the one in the young grass!
Homage to the one in the sand and to the one in the flowing stream!
Homage to the one in the pool and to the one in the whirlpool!
Homage to the one in the chasm and to the one dwelling in the abyss!
Homage to the one in the dry and to the one in the green!
Homage to the one in rough ground and to the one in grassy bush!
Homage to the one in the dust and to the one in the mist!
Homage to the one in the tubular conduit and to the one in the wave!
Homage to the leaf and to the falling leaf!
Homage to the tugger and to the violent tugger!
Homage to the one who strikes down and to the one raising [his weapon]!
Homage to the tearing one and to the rending one!

namo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānāṃ hṛdayebhyaḥ /
namo vicinvatkebhyḥ /
namo vikṣiṇatkebhyaḥ /
nama ānirhatebhyaḥ //
drāpe andhasaspate daridra nīlalohita /
āsāṃ prajānām eṣāṃ puruṣāṇām eṣāṃ paśūnām /
mā bhairmā ruṅ mā naḥ kiñcanāmamat //
imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya prabharāmahe matīḥ /
yathā naḥ śam asad dvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminn anāturam //
yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāha bheṣajī /
śivā rutasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase //
pari no rudrasya hetir vṛṇaktu pari tveṣasya durmatir aghāyoḥ /
ava sthirā maghavadbhyas tanuṣva mīḍhvas tokāya tanayāya mṛḍa //

meaning:
नमो वः किरिकेभ्यो देवानां हृदयेभ्यः /
नमो विचिन्वत्केभ्य्ः /
नमो विक्षिणत्केभ्यः /
नम आनिर्हतेभ्यः //
द्रापे अन्धसस्पते दरिद्र नीललोहित /
आसां प्रजानाम् एषां पुरुषाणाम् एषां पशूनाम् /
मा भैर्मा रुङ् मा नः किञ्चनाममत् //
इमा रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्रभरामहे मतीः /
यथा नः शम् असद् द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वं पुष्टं ग्रामे अस्मिन्न् अनातुरम् //
या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूः शिवा विश्वाह भेषजी /
शिवा रुतस्य भेषजी तया नो मृड जीवसे //
परि नो रुद्रस्य हेतिर् वृणक्तु परि त्वेषस्य दुर्मतिर् अघायोः /
अव स्थिरा मघवद्भ्यस् तनुष्व मीढ्वस् तोकाय तनयाय मृड //
मीढुष्टम शिवतम शिवो नः सुमना भव /
परमे वृक्ष आयुधं निधाय कृत्तिं वसान उच्चर पिनाकं बिभ्रद् उच्चर //
विकिरिद्र विलोहित नमस् ते अस्तु भगवः /
यास् ते सहस्रं हेतयो ऽन्यम् अस्मन् निवपन्तु ताः //
सहस्रधा सहस्राणि हेतयस् तव बाह्वोः /
तासाम् ईशानो भगवः पराचीना मुखा कुरु //
असंख्याता सहस्राणि ये रुद्रा अधि भूम्याम् /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये अस्मिन् महत्य् अर्णवे अन्तरिक्षे भवा अधि /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठा दिवं रुद्रा उपश्रिताः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठाः शर्वा अधः क्षमाचराः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये वनेषु शष्पिञ्जरा नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये ऽन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिवतो जनान् /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये भूतानाम् अधिपतयो विशिखासः कपर्दिनः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये पथीनां पथिरक्षय ईलमृडा यवधः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
ये तीर्थानि प्रचरन्ति सृकावन्तो निषङ्गिणः /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
य एतावन्तो वा भूयांसो वा दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे /
तेषां सहस्रयोजने ऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि //
नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि येषां वर्षम् इषवः /
तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर् दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर् दशोदीचीर् दशोर्ध्वाः /
तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु /
ते नो मृडयन्तु /
ते यं द्विष्मो यश् च नो द्वेष्टि तम् एषां जम्भे दधामि //
नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये ऽन्तरिक्षे येषां वात इषवः /
तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर् दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर् दशोदीचीर् दशोर्ध्वाः /
तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु /
ते नो मृडयन्तु /
ते यं द्विष्मो यश् च नो द्वेष्टि तम् एषां जम्भे दधामि //
नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्यां येषाम् अन्नम् इषवः /
तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर् दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर् दशोदीचीर् दशोर्ध्वाः /
तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु /
ते नो मृडयन्तु /
ते यं द्विष्मो यश् च नो द्वेष्टि तम् एषां जम्भे दधामि //
text_mt:
Homage to you, the Kirikas, the hearts of the gods!
Homage to the selectors!
Homage to the destroyers!
Homage to the expellers!
O Drāpi, lord of nourishment, impoverished one, blue-and-red one!
Towards these offspring, these men, these cattle,
do not be terrifying, do not cause disease, let nothing of ours be afflicted!
These thoughts we offer to Rudra, the strong, the matted-haired one, who rules over men,
so that there may be welfare for our two-footed and four-footed [creatures], and everything in this village may be nourished and free from illness.
That body of yours, O Rudra, which is auspicious, auspicious as an all-curing medicine,
auspicious as a remedy for affliction—with that, have mercy on us so that we may live!
May the missile of Rudra spare us, may the ill-will of the blazing, malevolent one pass us by!
Slacken your taut [bow] away from our patrons; O bountiful one, have mercy on our children and offspring!
O most bountiful one, most auspicious one, be auspicious and benevolent to us!
Having placed your weapon on the highest tree, clad in a hide, go forth; bearing the pināka, go forth!
O scatterer, crimson one, homage be to you, O lord!
Those missiles of yours which are a thousandfold, let them strike down someone other than us!
In thousands of ways, thousands are the missiles in your arms;
ruling over them, O lord, turn their points away!
Innumerable thousands are the Rudras upon the earth;
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
The Bhavas who are over this great ocean, the intermediate space—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
The blue-necked, white-throated Rudras who have resorted to heaven—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
The blue-necked, white-throated Śarvas who move below on the earth—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Those who are grass-red, blue-necked, crimson in the forests—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Those who pierce people in foods, and while drinking from vessels—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Those who are overlords of beings, crestless and matted-haired—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Those who are protectors of paths, food-guardians, causing grain to thrive—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Those who frequent the fords, bearing darts and carrying quivers—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
As many as these, or even more, the Rudras who have spread throughout the quarters—
a thousand leagues away we unstring their bows!
Homage be to the Rudras who are in heaven, whose arrows are the rain!
To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward!
Homage be to them!
May they have mercy on us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him I place into their jaws!
Homage be to the Rudras who are in the intermediate space, whose arrows are the wind!
To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward!
Homage be to them!
May they have mercy on us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him I place into their jaws!
Homage be to the Rudras who are on earth, whose arrows are food!
To them ten [fingers] eastward, ten southward, ten westward, ten northward, ten upward!
Homage be to them!
May they have mercy on us!
Whom we hate and who hates us, him I place into their jaws!

aśmann ūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇām adbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo 'dhi saṃbhṛtām /
tāṃ na ūrjaṃ dhatta marutaḥ saṃrarāṇā aśmaṃs te kṣud yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te śug ṛcchatu //
samudrasya tvāvakayāgne parivyayāmasi /
anyāṃs te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava //
himasya tvā jarāyuṇāgne parivyayāmasi /
anyāṃs te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava //
upa jmann upa vetase 'vatara nadīṣv ā /
agne pittam apām asi maṇḍūki tābhir āgahi /
semaṃ no yajñaṃ pāvakavarṇaṃ śivaṃ kṛdhi //
apām idaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya vimocanam /
anyāṃs te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava //
agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā /
ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca //
pāvakayā yaś citayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā /
turo na yāmann etaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ //
namas te harase śociṣe namas te astv arciṣe /
anyāṃs te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava //
nṛṣade vaḍ apsuṣade vaḍ varṣade vaḍ barhiṣade vaṭ svarvide vaṭ //
ye devā devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānāṃ saṃvatsarīṇam upa bhāgam āsate /
āhutādo haviṣo yajñe asmin svayaṃ pibantu madhuno ghṛtasya //
ye devā devebhyo adhi devatvam āyan ye brahmaṇaḥ puraetāro asya /
yebhyo narte pavate dhāma kiṃ cana na te divo pṛthivyā adhi snuṣu //
prāṇadā vyānadā apānadā varcodā varivodāḥ /
anyāṃs te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava //
meaning:
अश्मन्न् ऊर्जं पर्वते शिश्रियाणाम् अद्भ्य ओषधीभ्यो वनस्पतिभ्यो ऽधि संभृताम् /
तां न ऊर्जं धत्त मरुतः संरराणा अश्मंस् ते क्षुद् यं द्विष्मस् तं ते शुग् ऋच्छतु //
समुद्रस्य त्वावकयाग्ने परिव्ययामसि /
अन्यांस् ते अस्मत् तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव //
हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणाग्ने परिव्ययामसि /
अन्यांस् ते अस्मत् तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव //
उप ज्मन्न् उप वेतसे ऽवतर नदीष्व् आ /
अग्ने पित्तम् अपाम् असि मण्डूकि ताभिर् आगहि /
सेमं नो यज्ञं पावकवर्णं शिवं कृधि //
अपाम् इदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य विमोचनम् /
अन्यांस् ते अस्मत् तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव //
अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया /
आ देवान् वक्षि यक्षि च //
पावकया यश् चितयन्त्या कृपा क्षामन् रुरुच उषसो न भानुना /
तुरो न यामन्न् एतशस्य नू रण आ यो घृणे न ततृषाणो अजरः //
नमस् ते हरसे शोचिषे नमस् ते अस्त्व् अर्चिषे /
अन्यांस् ते अस्मत् तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव //
नृषदे वड् अप्सुषदे वड् वर्षदे वड् बर्हिषदे वट् स्वर्विदे वट् //
ये देवा देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियानां संवत्सरीणम् उप भागम् आसते /
आहुतादो हविषो यज्ञे अस्मिन् स्वयं पिबन्तु मधुनो घृतस्य //
ये देवा देवेभ्यो अधि देवत्वम् आयन् ये ब्रह्मणः पुरएतारो अस्य /
येभ्यो नर्ते पवते धाम किं चन न ते दिवो पृथिव्या अधि स्नुषु //
प्राणदा व्यानदा अपानदा वर्चोदा वरिवोदाः /
अन्यांस् ते अस्मत् तपन्तु हेतयः पावको अस्मभ्यं शिवो भव //
text_mt:
The sap resting in the rock, in the mountain, gathered from waters, plants, and trees—
bestow that sap upon us, O Maruts, in harmony! Let your hunger go into the rock; let your burning heat reach the one whom we hate!
With the water-plant of the sea, O Agni, we envelop you.
Let your missiles burn others away from us; be purifying and auspicious to us!
With the membrane of snow, O Agni, we envelop you.
Let your missiles burn others away from us; be purifying and auspicious to us!
Go to the earth, go to the reed, descend into the rivers!
O Agni, you are the bile of the waters; O female frog, come with them;
make this sacrifice of ours purifying in appearance and auspicious!
Here is the descending place of the waters, the release-place of the sea.
Let your missiles burn others away from us; be purifying and auspicious to us!
O Agni, purifying one, with your brilliant light, with your delightful tongue, O god,
bring the gods hither and sacrifice to them!
Who with purifying, awakening beauty shone upon the earth as with the beam of dawn,
swift as on the march of Etaśa, now in battle, who like one thirsting in heat is ageless—
Homage to your heat, to your flame! Homage be to your radiant beam!
Let your missiles burn others away from us; be purifying and auspicious to us!
To the one seated among men, vaṭ! To the one seated in the waters, vaṭ! To the one seated in the rain, vaṭ! To the one seated on the sacred grass, vaṭ! To the one who finds the light of heaven, vaṭ!
The gods who, worthy of sacrifice among the gods, worthy of sacrifice, sit near the yearly portion,
eaters of the oblation, let them drink of the sweet ghee themselves at this sacrifice!
The gods who attained godhead from the gods, who are the leaders of this Brahman,
without whom no domain whatever is purified, nor are they upon the peaks of heaven and earth—
Giver of in-breath, giver of cross-breath, giver of out-breath, giver of splendor, giver of wide space!
Let your missiles burn others away from us; be purifying and auspicious to us!

sanskrit_iast:
agnis tigmena śociṣā yāsad viśvaṃ ny atriṇam /
agnir no vanate rayim //
ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvad ṛṣir hotā nyasīdat pitā naḥ /
sa āśiṣā draviṇam icchamānaḥ prathamacchad avarāṃ āviveśa //
viśvakarmā vimanā yo vyomā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk /
teṣām iṣṭāni sam iṣā madanti yatrā saptarṣīn para ekam āhuḥ //
ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ sam asmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā /
asūrtā sūrte rajasi niṣattā ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvann imāni //
yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā yo naḥ sato abhy ā san nināya /
yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eko asti taṃ saṃpraśnaṃ bhuvanā yanty anyā //
na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyad yuṣmākam antaraṃ babhūva /
nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaś caranti //
viśvakarmā ced ajaniṣṭa deva ād id gandharvo abhavad dvitīyaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ pitā janitauṣadhīnām apāṃ garbhaṃ vyadadhāt purutrā //
paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhir asurair yad asti /
kaṃ svid garbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhrur āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve //
tam id garbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhrur āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta sarve /
ajasya nābhāv adhy ekam arpitaṃ tatredaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam adhi śritam //
cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtam ene ajanan namnamāne /
yad id dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ād id antā adadṛhanta pūrve //
kiṃ svid vanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīd yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ /
manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchated u tad yad adhyatiṣṭhad bhuvanāni dhārayan //
kiṃ svid āsīd ārambhaṇam adhiṣṭhānaṃ katamat svit kathāsīt /
yato bhūmiṃ janayan viśvakarmā vi dyām aurṇon mahinā viśvacakṣāḥ //
yo viśvataścakṣur uta viśvatomukho viśvatohasta uta viśvataspāt /
saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrair dyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ //
yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmann utemā /
śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ juṣāṇaḥ //
viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ svā hi te /
muhyantv anye abhito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrir astu //
viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāram indram akṛṇor avadhyam /
tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta pūrvīr ayam ugro vihavyo yathāsat //
vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇam ūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyāhuvema /
sa no nediṣṭhaṃ havanāny āgamad viśvaśaṃbhūr avase sādhukarmā //
meaning:
अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद् विश्वं न्य् अत्रिणम् /
अग्निर् नो वनते रयिम् //
य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वद् ऋषिर् होता न्यसीदत् पिता नः /
स आशिषा द्रविणम् इच्छमानः प्रथमच्छद् अवरां आविवेश //
विश्वकर्मा विमना यो व्योमा धाता विधाता परमोत संदृक् /
तेषाम् इष्टानि सम् इषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तर्षीन् पर एकम् आहुः //
त आयजन्त द्रविणं सम् अस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना /
असूर्ता सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ता ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्न् इमानि //
यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता यो नः सतो अभ्य् आ सन् निनाय /
यो देवानां नामधा एको अस्ति तं संप्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्य् अन्या //
न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानान्यद् युष्माकम् अन्तरं बभूव /
नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चासुतृप उक्थशासश् चरन्ति //
विश्वकर्मा चेद् अजनिष्ट देव आद् इद् गन्धर्वो अभवद् द्वितीयः /
तृतीयः पिता जनितौषधीनाम् अपां गर्भं व्यदधात् पुरुत्रा //
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिर् असुरैर् यद् अस्ति /
कं स्विद् गर्भं प्रथमं दध्रुर् आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त विश्वे //
तम् इद् गर्भं प्रथमं दध्रुर् आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त सर्वे /
अजस्य नाभाव् अध्य् एकम् अर्पितं तत्रेदं विश्वं भुवनम् अधि श्रितम् //
चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतम् एने अजनन् नम्नमाने /
यद् इद् द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम् आद् इद् अन्ता अददृहन्त पूर्वे //
किं स्विद् वनं क उ स वृक्ष आसीद् यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः /
मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेद् उ तद् यद् अध्यतिष्ठद् भुवनानि धारयन् //
किं स्विद् आसीद् आरम्भणम् अधिष्ठानं कतमत् स्वित् कथासीत् /
यतो भूमिं जनयन् विश्वकर्मा वि द्याम् और्णोन् महिना विश्वचक्षाः //
यो विश्वतश्चक्षुर् उत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोहस्त उत विश्वतस्पात् /
सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर् द्यावापृथिवी जनयन् देव एकः //
या ते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्न् उतेमा /
शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं जुषाणः //
विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं स्वा हि ते /
मुह्यन्त्व् अन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिर् अस्तु //
विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वर्धनेन त्रातारम् इन्द्रम् अकृणोर् अवध्यम् /
तस्मै विशः समनमन्त पूर्वीर् अयम् उग्रो विहव्यो यथासत् //
वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणम् ऊतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्याहुवेम /
स नो नेदिष्ठं हवनान्य् आगमद् विश्वशंभूर् अवसे साधुकर्मा //
text_mt:
Agni with sharp flame shall strike down every devourer;
Agni shall win wealth for us.
He who, offering all these worlds, sat down as ṛṣi, hotṛ, our father,
he, seeking wealth through prayer, disguising the first, entered the later [creations].
Viśvakarman, of wide mind, of wide extension, the maker, the disposer, and the highest survey;
their offerings rejoice together with nourishment where they say the seven ṛṣis are beyond the One.
They sacrificed wealth together to him, the ancient ṛṣis like singers with abundance,
unfathomable, seated in the fathomless realm of space, who made these beings.
He who is our father, generator, who is the disposer, who brought our [creations] into existence from what is,
who alone is the name-giver of the gods—to him as the question all other worlds go.
You do not know him who engendered these [worlds]; another thing has come between you:
shrouded in mist and with idle talk, breath-eaters, recitation-chanters go about.
When Viśvakarman the god was born, then the Gandharva became the second;
the third, the father, the generator of plants, placed the germ of the waters in many places.
Beyond heaven, beyond this earth, beyond what is of gods and asuras—
what first germ did the waters bear, wherein all the gods looked together?
The waters indeed bore that first germ, wherein all the gods looked together,
placed upon the navel of the Unborn as the One, wherein this entire world is set.
Father of the eye, for he is wise in mind, he generated these two yielding [realms] as ghee,
when heaven and earth spread out; then the ancient ends became firm.
What indeed was the forest, and what was that tree from which they fashioned heaven and earth?
Ask that, O wise ones, with your mind, upon what he stood when supporting the worlds.
What indeed was the foothold, which the support, how was it,
from where Viśvakarman, all-seeing, generating the earth, unfolded heaven by his greatness?
He who has eyes on all sides and faces on all sides, hands on all sides and feet on all sides,
welds them together with his arms, with his wings, the one god generating heaven and earth.
Those which are your highest domains, which are the lowest, and which are the middle ones, O Viśvakarman,
teach them to your friends at the oblation, O self-dependent one! Sacrifice to your own body yourself, delighting in it!
O Viśvakarman, strengthened by the oblation, sacrifice to your body yourself, for it is your own;
let other people around be confounded; here let the generous patron be ours!
O Viśvakarman, through the strengthening oblation you made Indra a protector, unslayable;
to him the many clans bowed down, so that he should be fierce and invocable by all.
Viśvakarman, Vācaspati, swift as thought, we would invoke today for aid in the contest for booty;
let him, all-beneficent, of good works, come to our invocations nearest of all for our protection!

sanskrit_iast:
ud enam uttarāṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta /
rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃsṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi //
indremaṃ prataraṃ kṛdhi sajātānām asad vaśī /
sam enaṃ varcasā sṛja devebhyo bhāgadā asat //
yasya kurmo gṛhe havir tam agne vardhayā tvam /
tasmai devā adhibruvann ayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ //
ud u tvā viśve devāḥ //
pañca diśo daivīr yajñam avantu devīr apāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānāḥ /
rāyaspoṣe yajñapatim ābhajantī rāyaspoṣe adhi yajño asthāt //
samiddhe agnāv adhi māmahāna ukthapatra īḍyo gṛhītaḥ /
taptaṃ gharmaṃ parigṛhyāyajantorjā yad yajñam ayajanta devāḥ //
daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre devaśrīḥ śrīmanāḥ śatapāt /
parigṛhya yajñam āyan //
harikeśaḥ sūryaraśmiḥ purastāt savitā jyotir udayāṃ ajasram /
tasya pūṣā prasave yāti devaḥ saṃpaśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ //
devā devebhyo adhvaryanto asthur vītaṃ śamitaṃ śamitā yajadhyai /
turyo yajñā yatra havyam eti tato vākā āśiṣo no juṣantām //
vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam /
sa viśvācī abhicaṣṭe ghṛtācī antarā pūrvam aparaṃ ca ketum //
ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ pitur āviveśa /
madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśnir aśmā vicakrame rajasaḥ pāty antau //
indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ /
rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim //
sumnahūr yajña ā ca vakṣat /
yakṣad agnir devo devāṃ ā ca vakṣat //
vājasya mā prasavenodgrābheṇodajīgṛbham /
athā sapatnān indro me nigrābheṇādharāṃ akaḥ //
udgrābhaś ca nigrābhaś ca brahma devāṃ avīvṛdhat /
athā sapatnān indrāgnī me viṣūcīnān vyasyatām //
meaning:
उद् एनम् उत्तरां नयाग्ने घृतेनाहुत /
रायस्पोषेण संसृज प्रजया च बहुं कृधि //
इन्द्रेमं प्रतरं कृधि सजातानाम् असद् वशी /
सम् एनं वर्चसा सृज देवेभ्यो भागदा असत् //
यस्य कुर्मो गृहे हविर् तम् अग्ने वर्धया त्वम् /
तस्मै देवा अधिब्रुवन्न् अयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः //
उद् उ त्वा विश्वे देवाः //
पञ्च दिशो दैवीर् यज्ञम् अवन्तु देवीर् अपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमानाः /
रायस्पोषे यज्ञपतिम् आभजन्ती रायस्पोषे अधि यज्ञो अस्थात् //
समिद्धे अग्नाव् अधि मामहान उक्थपत्र ईड्यो गृहीतः /
तप्तं घर्मं परिगृह्यायजन्तोर्जा यद् यज्ञम् अयजन्त देवाः //
दैव्याय धर्त्रे जोष्ट्रे देवश्रीः श्रीमनाः शतपात् /
परिगृह्य यज्ञम् आयन् //
हरिकेशः सूर्यरश्मिः पुरस्तात् सविता ज्योतिर् उदयां अजस्रम् /
तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति देवः संपश्यन् विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः //
देवा देवेभ्यो अध्वर्यन्तो अस्थुर् वीतं शमितं शमिता यजध्यै /
तुर्यो यज्ञा यत्र हव्यम् एति ततो वाका आशिषो नो जुषन्ताम् //
विमान एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान् रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् /
स विश्वाची अभिचष्टे घृताची अन्तरा पूर्वम् अपरं च केतुम् //
उक्षा समुद्रो अरुणः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुर् आविवेश /
मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निर् अश्मा विचक्रमे रजसः पात्य् अन्तौ //
इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः /
रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् //
सुम्नहूर् यज्ञ आ च वक्षत् /
यक्षद् अग्निर् देवो देवां आ च वक्षत् //
वाजस्य मा प्रसवेनोद्ग्राभेणोदजीगृभम् /
अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्रो मे निग्राभेणाधरां अकः //
उद्ग्राभश् च निग्राभश् च ब्रह्म देवां अवीवृधत् /
अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्राग्नी मे विषूचीनान् व्यस्यताम् //
text_mt:
Lead him higher upward, O Agni, when offered with ghee; / endow him with increase of wealth, and make him abundant in offspring!
O Indra, advance this man further, so that he becomes the ruler of his kinsmen; / endow him with splendor, that he may give portions to the gods!
In whose house we prepare the oblation, him, O Agni, do you cause to prosper; / for him may the gods speak favorably, and this Bṛhaspati!
Upward, indeed, you, all the gods...
May the five divine quarters favor the sacrifice, the goddesses thrusting away lack of thought and ill will; / admitting the lord of the sacrifice to increase of wealth, upon increase of wealth the sacrifice has stood.
Exalted at the kindled Agni, with śastras as wings, worthy of praise, seized; / grasping the heated gharma, they sacrificed with sap when the gods sacrificed the sacrifice.
For the divine upholder, the cherisher, radiant with divine beauty, splendor-minded, hundred-footed; / grasping the sacrifice, they went.
Golden-haired, sun-rayed in the east, Savitṛ [raises] his perpetual light; / at his impulse god Pūṣan moves, the protector surveying all beings.
As Adhvaryus the gods stood for the gods, [inviting]: 'Come, slaughter, O slaughterer, to sacrifice!' / Where the fourth sacrifice goes to the oblation, thence may the wishes rejoice in our prayers.
This measure rests in the midst of heaven, having filled both heaven and earth and the intermediate space; / he watches over the all-pervading, ghee-laden [regions] between the earlier and the later beacon.
The bull, the sea, the ruddy eagle has entered the womb of the ancient father; / set in the midst of heaven, the speckled stone has strode out; he guards the two ends of space.
All songs have magnified Indra, spacious as the sea, / best charioteer of charioteers, lord, lord of prizes.
May the sacrifice, invoking favor, bring [them] here! / May Agni the god sacrifice to the gods and bring [them] here!
By the impulse of strength, with the uplifting [scoop], I have uplifted [myself]; / then may Indra by the down-holding [scoop] make my rivals inferior!
The uplifting and the down-holding, [and] the sacred word have magnified the gods; / then may Indra and Agni scatter my rivals in different directions!

kramadhvam agninā nākam ukhyaṃ hasteṣu vibhrataḥ /
divas pṛṣṭhaṃ svar gatvā miśrā devebhir ādhvam //
prācīm anu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān //
pṛthivyā aham ud antarikṣam āruham antarikṣād divam āruham /
divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt svar jyotir agām aham /
svar yanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṃ rohanti rodasī /
yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṃ suvidvāṃso vitenire //
agne prehi prathamo devayatāṃ cakṣur devānām uta martyānām /
iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ svar yantu yajamānāḥ svasti //
naktoṣāsā //
agne sahasrākṣa śatamūrdhañ chatatejaḥ śataṃ te prāṇāḥ sahasraṃ vyānāḥ /
tvaṃ sāhasrasya rāya īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā //
suparṇo 'si garutmān pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda /
bhāsāntarikṣam āpṛṇa jyotiṣā divam uttabhāna tejasā diśa uddṛṃha //
ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastād agne svaṃ yonim āsīda sādhyā /
asmin sadhasthe adhy uttarasmin viśve devā yajamānaś ca sīdata //
tāṃ savitur vareṇyasya citrām āhaṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvajanyām /
